<section class="dm-page-header">
  <div class="dm-container">
    <h1>Careers</h1>
    <p>DataMetricus engages specialist collaborators on a project basis.</p>

<section class="dm-section dm-section--white">
  <div class="dm-container">
    <div style="max-width:640px;">
      <p>DataMetricus operates as an independent advisory. It does not maintain a standing team. Where projects require additional expertise, we collaborate with a small number of trusted quantitative specialists.</p>

      <p>Collaborations are engagement-specific and based on methodological alignment, demonstrated experience in regulated or oversight-driven contexts, and disciplined reproducible analytical practice.</p>

      <p>We are not actively recruiting. However, we maintain a limited network of professionals in actuarial modelling, applied statistics, epidemiology, and related quantitative fields for potential future engagements.</p>

      <p>If your expertise aligns with this profile and you wish to be considered for future collaboration, please send a brief introduction outlining your experience, areas of specialisation, and availability.</p>

      <div class="dm-mt-32">
        <a href="contact.html" class="dm-btn dm-btn--primary">Submit expression of interest</a>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
